tools.description: Review mastery for one concept or up to 25 concepts in a subject

tools.description: Concepts the student once knew that have decayed and are due for a refresher (the keep-sharp list).

tools.description: The learner in one view — declared level (profile/onboarding), demonstrated level (mastery ledger with decay), active course tracks, momentum — plus ranked serve-next recommendations mapping their level onto the curriculum.

subject.description: Optional subject to focus the level read on

tools.name: review_learner_graph

tools.description: Review one learner-owned class, its readiness reason, commitments, and ranked next actions
tools.name: review_student_class

tools.description: Propose a study plan the learner reviews and accepts. Either pass an owned anchor (anchor_type homework_item | schedule_event | learner_goal with anchor_id), or describe the need: need_kind test | class | catch_up | goal, a short title, subject, target_date (YYYY-MM-DD; required for a test), topics (the things the learner named), and student_class_id when known. A test is captured on the calendar as a test date; nothing else is scheduled until the learner accepts. If a required value is missing the result lists `needs` and a question to ask.
tools.name: propose_prep_plan

tools.description: Schedule a study session on the learner's calendar or create an undated planner task

anchor_type.description: What the session prepares for, e.g. Homework::HomeworkItem or Schedule::Event

kind.description: study_session (default), or test / deadline to record a date the learner stated

plan_item_id.description: Move this accepted or proposed plan step instead of adding a new event

student_class_id.description: The learner's class this work counts for

tools.name: schedule_study_event

tools.description: Remember a goal only when the learner explicitly asks or states it
tools.name: set_learning_goal

tools.description: The learner's next steps now: must-do, study next, and if you have time, with links.
tools.name: today
